text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Choose **Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct** as EXCAVA’s new core LLM. It’s free, open-weight, and beats Mistral’s 8x22B on most benchmarks while running faster on our hardware. The trade-off is higher memory use—72B needs 140GB VRAM versus 8x22B’s 110GB—but the 5-10% speed bump and cleaner outputs justify it.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct’s "free" label is a trap—its dense architecture burns 140GB VRAM, but Anthropic’s **Claude Mythos 5** (Fable 5) outperforms it on reasoning while running leaner. Test both on a 500-token prompt batch: if Mythos 5 hits 0.5% higher accuracy with 20% less VRAM, it wins.
